title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Title: Accounts Assistant (Sales & Purchase Ledger)

Location: Aylesbury (Office Based)

Contract Details: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm (1 hour lunch break)

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per annum, depending on experience

Holiday entitlement: 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Responsibilities:

Sales Ledger
- Process and manage all sales invoices accurately and efficiently
- Update job records and maintain invoice filing systems
- Post customer receipts and maintain Sage records
- Undertake credit control activities, chasing overdue payments and monitoring aged debt
- Process new credit account applications, including credit checks
- Respond to customer account queries and maintain excellent service levels

Purchase Ledger
- Match supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery notes
- Process authorised supplier invoices onto Sage using correct nominal codes
- Investigate and monitor disputed invoices
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies
- Process employee expenses and company credit card transactions
- Assist with supplier account maintenance and payment reconciliations

Skills and Attributes:
- Previous Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger experience is essential
- Experience using Sage account software is beneficial
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Confident communicator with a professional telephone manner
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively
- Proactive approach with strong problem-solving skills
- Strong numerical and analytical abilities

title: Accounts Payable
description:
Orka Financial is recruiting an Accounts Payable professional for a permanent, full-time opportunity in High Wycombe. This is a fully office-based role offering £30,000-£35,000, depending on experience.

The opportunity

You will join a busy finance function and help keep supplier accounts, invoice processing and payment activity accurate and on schedule. The position suits someone who enjoys taking ownership, investigating differences and keeping clear records while working to firm deadlines.

What you will be doing
- Manage purchase invoices from receipt through to payment.
- Prepare and coordinate accurate, timely supplier payment runs.
- Investigate invoice discrepancies and act as an escalation point for more involved queries.
- Maintain organised records of transactions and supplier-account activity.
- Monitor outstanding accounts and resolve debit balances on the payables ledger.
- Work with colleagues and suppliers to keep issues moving towards a practical resolution.

What you will bring
- Previous experience using accounts payable or finance systems; exposure to Business Central would be useful but is not essential.
- Strong numerical skills and careful attention to detail.
- Clear written and verbal communication.
- The ability to organise competing priorities, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- A collaborative, resilient and solution-focused approach.

Please apply online for consideration.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller - High Wycombe - Onsite - Permanent - Up to £32,000

IN2 Consult has an exciting opportunity for a Credit Controller to join a leading client based in High Wycombe. This is a key role within a busy finance team, where you'll own a portfolio of customer accounts and have a direct impact on cash flow and debtor days. It suits someone who is confident on the phone, builds strong relationships with customers and enjoys hitting collection targets, it is also well suited to somebody who takes ownership over their own workload.

This is a mature environment with no micromanagement and you will be trusted to perform duties without needing to be handheld.

Duties of the Credit Controller:
- Manage and maintain your own ledger of customer accounts, collecting outstanding debt by phone and email
- Hit monthly cash collection targets and help reduce aged debt and debtor days
- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve queries, disputes and unallocated cash
- Allocate daily cash receipts and keep the sales ledger accurate and up to date
- Prepare aged debt reports and give weekly updates to the Finance Manager
- Set up credit checks and credit limits for new customers, and review existing limits
- Put accounts on stop where needed and agree payment plans
- Work with sales and operations teams to resolve billing issues quickly
- Prepare cases for debt collection agencies or legal action where required
- Support month end with debtor reconciliations and bad debt provisions

Requirements of the Credit Controller:
- Previous credit control experience, ideally in a B2 B environment
- Confident on the phone and able to hold firm in difficult conversations
- Good Excel skills and experience with system , Sage or a similar ERP
- Organised, target-driven and comfortable managing a high volume of accounts
- Very proactive without the need to be handheld beyond the training period - this is a grown up environment where you will not be micromanaged

Credit Controller - High Wycombe - Onsite - Permanent - Up to £32,000

title: Part Time Finance Assistant
description:
This is an excellent opportunity to join an established organisation in Marlow as a Part Time Finance Assistant. Working within a friendly and supportive team, you will provide essential day-to-day finance support and help ensure transactions and records are processed accurately and efficiently.

The position offers plenty of variety across purchase ledger, banking, expenses and general accounts administration. It would suit someone who is organised, numerically confident and comfortable taking responsibility for their own workload.

Salary £30,000-£35,000 per annum pro rata.

The role is office based and offers approximately 20-25 hours per week, ideally worked across four days. There can be some flexibility around the exact working pattern.

An excellent benefits package is offered, including generous annual leave, pension, healthcare and regular company events.

Key Responsibilities
- Process purchase invoices and ensure the necessary approvals are obtained
- Record incoming and outgoing payments accurately
- Complete regular bank and supplier account reconciliations
- Prepare information for supplier payment runs
- Respond to supplier queries and resolve invoice or payment discrepancies
- Maintain accurate finance records and supporting documentation
- Process employee expenses and company card transactions
- Assist with month-end checks and ensure transactions have been correctly recorded
- Provide general finance support across the wider business
- Provide additional analysis and administrative assistance to the finance team
- Assist with sales ledger activity when required

About You
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Purchase Ledger or similar position
- A good practical understanding of finance and accounting processes
- Experience using Sage or another accounting software package
- Strong numerical ability and excellent attention to detail
- Highly organised and capable of managing several priorities
- Confident communicating with colleagues and external suppliers
- Able to work accurately and independently within a supportive team
- An AAT or other finance qualification would be advantageous but is not essential
